name: In Favor of Elune

footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, you must travel to Dolanaar when your business here in Shadowglen is done. There, you will find Laurna Morninglight. She will instruct you further in the ways of Elune, and it is with her that you will earn your first garments denoting your station as a priest of Elune.

Take care, and may you be protected in your journeys.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Laurna Morninglight in Teldrassil.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm happy to see Shanda has sent you to find me, adventurer. Teaching young priests the ways of Elune gives me great satisfaction.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 4, 360 XP in all.
